fixtures.contract: An active-turn record whose start is null decodes and re-encodes without dropping fields.

The activity snapshot carries the gateway's epoch, a revision seeded from wall-clock milliseconds and incremented per change, per-provider and agent-ownership coverage and each gateway turn's start sequence.
The plain-text block and message the composer appends for uploaded files; the app and the live upload probe send the same bytes.
Swift history projection and Claude header summaries accept the same valid pasted-text envelopes and preserve malformed or ordinary marker-shaped text.

Length-delimited inline pastes and escaped literal text preserve UTF-8 payloads and composed order, including nested reserved tags; malformed markers remain ordinary text. Swift projection, Claude headers and APNs summaries agree.
Typed v1/v2 markers remain literal text around an ordered paste; current checkpoints retain chip identity and old decoders receive readable expanded text.
An ordered inline pasted-text message persists exact paste identity and order while old decoders receive expanded readable text.
A checkpoint written by main 9db89687 loads without inventing attachments for unmarked historical pasted text.
Sent attachment checkpoints preserve the original body and attachment order while retaining readable legacy text, image and file fields for rollback builds.

The per-device registration the app sends to each host: one deviceId, the bundle, the APNs environment, the app's host id and the device's alert, Live Activity, VoIP and location tokens (the location token carries its navigation start inputs).
A conversation with a pending exclusive command refuses transiently and says when to retry.
A history cursor whose anchor is gone or unparseable.
A history page over the response budget reports its measured size.
A queued-message add, start or delete whose outcome Codex never confirmed; the client rereads the queue instead of retrying.
Claude stopped reading its input after the gateway queued this one; it still arrives if Claude resumes, so the client treats delivery as unconfirmed and never resends it.
A steer or Stop that names a turn that is not running.
Owned error payload for a conversation metadata revision conflict.
A stored conversation metadata record round-trips without renaming or dropping fields.
A conversation metadata mutation round-trips without renaming or dropping fields.
Sanitized incident: a question answered outside the history viewport the app had loaded.
The host question snapshot after that answer.
Notification replay page after the gateway epoch changed.
Notification replay page that is full and has more to read.
Notification replay page that skipped one thread and marks only it for recovery.
Owned error payload for a request refused for capacity.
Owned error payload for a voice call that has ended.
